name: Domain Decomposition Training and Inference
definition: A strategy to fit large-scale volumes by dividing the data into a grid of bricks and training one SRN per brick in parallel on multiple GPUs, avoiding out-of-core I/O overhead.
summary: Domain Decomposition Training and Inference partitions large volumes into bricks for parallel GPU training, avoiding out-of-core I/O and accelerating inference via spatial hashing.
